pins.claim: Default string ORDER BY is binary UTF-8 byte order: all ASCII uppercase < lowercase; multibyte (ß U+00DF, é U+00E9, snowman U+2603) sort after ASCII by leading byte
pins.query: SELECT s FROM (VALUES ('B'),('Z'),('a'),('e'),('ss'),('ß'),('é'),('☃')) t(s) ORDER BY s

pins.claim: IS NOT DISTINCT FROM is the null-safe equality: NULL~NULL is true, value~NULL is false — the plan's JoinKey null_safe=true spelling in DuckDB
pins.query: SELECT NULL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL, 1 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL, 1 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 1

pins.claim: Integer / is float division (DOUBLE), // is integer division — two distinct signatures for the registry
Negative integer // and % semantics, recorded for the Spark/BigQuery signature mapping
CAST is strict (errors on bad input), TRY_CAST is the try form (NULL on bad input) — the plan's Cast{strict|try} split
pins.query:
SELECT TRY_CAST('x' AS INTEGER)
SELECT CAST('x' AS INTEGER)
pins.observed: [(None,)] | ERROR: Conversion Error: Could not convert string 'x' to INT32

pins.claim: Strict CAST overflow errors by name (INT32 bound), TRY_CAST nulls it
pins.query:
SELECT CAST(3000000000 AS INTEGER)
SELECT TRY_CAST(3000000000 AS INTEGER)
pins.observed: ERROR: Conversion Error: Type INT64 with value 3000000000 can't be cast because the value is out of range for the destination type INT32 | [(None,)]
